Photorealistic wide horizontal LED billboard advertisement photographed from the street at night. An abstract fashion campaign: a woman in a flowing emerald-green coat against a warm amber-to-rose gradient, soft studio light, cinematic and elegant, generous empty space at the left for copy. The panel glows with restrained bloom, subtle pixel structure and a faint vertical panel seam. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Ultra-wide banner composition, edge-to-edge image, sharp and realistic.
